title: Statistics & Probability
description: Mean, median, mode, range, charts, and probability.

questions.question: What is the mode of: 2, 3, 3, 5, 7, 3?
questions.explanation: The mode is the number that appears most often. 3 appears three times.

questions.question: What is the median of: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5?
questions.explanation: The median is the middle value when ordered. Middle value is 3.

questions.question: If I flip a fair coin, what's the probability of getting heads?
questions.explanation: A fair coin has two equally likely outcomes, so P(heads) = 1/2

questions.question: The mean of 5, 7, 9, and 11 is?
A bag contains 3 red balls and 5 blue balls. What's the probability of drawing a red ball?
questions.explanation: Total balls = 8. P(red) = 3/8

questions.question: The range of these numbers is: 3, 7, 2, 9, 5
questions.explanation: Range = highest - lowest = 9 - 2 = 7

questions.question: A bag contains balls with numbers 1 to 10. What's the probability of drawing an even number?
questions.explanation: Even numbers from 1 to 10: 2, 4, 6, 8, 10 (that's 5). P(even) = 5/10 = 1/2

questions.question: This pie chart shows how a class travels to school. What percentage walk?
questions.explanation: Percentages must sum to 100%. Car (35%) + Bus (25%) = 60%. So Walk = 100% - 60% = 40%

questions.question: This spinner is divided into equal sections. What's the probability of landing on blue?
questions.explanation: Blue takes up 3 out of 6 equal sections. P(blue) = 3/6 = 1/2

questions.question: A die is rolled once. What is the probability of NOT rolling a 6?
Two coins are flipped. What is the probability that both land on heads?
questions.explanation: There are 4 equally likely outcomes (HH, HT, TH, TT), and only 1 is both heads, so P(both heads) = 1/4

questions.question: What is the mean of: 4, 8, 6, 10, 12?
What is the mode of: 5, 9, 5, 2, 9, 5, 7?
questions.explanation: 5 appears three times, more often than any other value, so the mode is 5

questions.question: What is the median of: 3, 7, 8, 12, 14, 20?
questions.explanation: With 6 values, the median is the average of the 3rd and 4th values: (8 + 12) ÷ 2 = 10

questions.question: What is the range of: 15, 22, 9, 31, 18?
questions.explanation: Range = highest - lowest = 31 - 9 = 22

questions.question: Team A scored 10, 14, 18 in three games. Team B scored 12, 12, 16 in three games. Which team has the higher mean score?
questions.explanation: Team A's mean = (10+14+18) ÷ 3 = 14. Team B's mean = (12+12+16) ÷ 3 ≈ 13.3. Team A is higher

questions.question: A bag contains only red marbles. What is the probability of picking a blue marble?
questions.explanation: Since there are no blue marbles in the bag, picking one is impossible

questions.question: This frequency table shows how many pets students in a class have. How many students have exactly 2 pets?
questions.explanation: Reading the table, the frequency for 2 pets is 6
